title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1991-09-20
lineage: Master Cassette > Nakamichi BX-125E > EMU 0202 > Wavelab > wav (24/96) > flac
source: Nakamichi 300 shotguns > Sony WM-D6 > 2 x Maxell XL II-S 90                taped by John Bleich from section U, row k, seat 7

ai_review.summary: Audience‑recorded show shines with a heartfelt Help → Slipknot → Fire sequence and a superb Bird Song, captured in good‑quality crowd recording.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the emotional impact of this performance – especially the cheering second set and the smoking Help>Slip>Fire transition, plus a tightly played Bird Song and an inspired Watchtower → Morning Dew pairing. The audience (aud) source picks up the crowd’s excitement nicely, providing a clear enough listen for fans despite not being a soundboard tape.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave five stars and highlighted multiple standout songs; the show is praised highly while the audience recording is described as clear enough to capture crowd response, leading to a strong overall rating despite limited technical detail.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape captures the crowd’s reaction well; no major complaints about muddiness or drop‑outs, sound is clear enough for enjoyment of key moments.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set II is highlighted for its cheering crowd and seamless transitions, especially the Help>Slip>Fire sequence; overall flow is described as uplifting and memorable.
